messages:
carla_mktg: Hey runtime — we need a compact "sanity pack" for launch collateral. Scope: streaming + function-calls demo, plus coldstart vs warmed worker comparison, quantized vs fp16, and one long-context stress probe. Need artifacts + small sanitized prompt set by COB Wednesday.

ryan_runtime: Copy. Which models and what traffic shape? Also do you want per-token gpu-ms or only end-to-end latencies?

carla_mktg: Targets: open-3b-quant, open-7b-quant, open-7b-fp16. Traffic: human-like typing (3 users, 3 short turns ~30 tokens, then 1 long probe ~1600 tokens). Please capture per-request p50/p90/p95/p99, per-chunk streaming p90, and gpu-ms if easily available. Short README with exact CLI and env.

jamal_devx: Ill paste a tiny harness payload to reproduce typing + streaming chunking. Use it and stamp harness SHA.

jamal_devx: ```json
{
  "scenario":"sanity_pack",
  "users":3,
  "short_turns":3,
  "short_avg_tokens":30,
  "long_probe_tokens":1600,
  "typing_delay_ms_range":[30,140],
  "stream_chunk_ms":150,
  "function_call":true,
  "seed":7890
}
```

ryan_runtime: Nice. Plan: quick smoke run on quantized 3b/7b now, full sweep including fp16 tomorrow morning. Well produce perf.jsonl (per-request with chunk_index & chunk_latency), metrics.csv (1s samples), a sanitized_prompts.json, and README.txt with exact run commands and env (CUDA/driver/runtime tag). Example CLI well include:```bash
redwood-bench --model open-7b-quant --profile sanity_pack --harness samples/sanity_harness.json --out ./artifacts/3647890123 --concurrency 3 --seed 7890
```

emily_eval: Ill prepare a 25-prompt function-call fidelity suite checking schema and argument completeness, plus 8 long-context coherence checks. Ill attach a pass/fail CSV and flag any prompt ids that regress. ETA tomorrow 14:00 PT.

benchbot: Run queued: id=rb-2026-3647890123-A, targets=[open-3b-quant,open-7b-quant], profile=sanity_pack, expected=18m. Artifacts will be uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/3647890123_A/ when finished.

ryan_runtime: Well also include a small heatmap image comparing coldstart p99 vs warmed p99 per-variant and a short provenance.txt: harness-sha, seed, runtime-image. Well sanitize prompts by replacing identifiers with placeholders and include a synthetic_map.txt describing replacements.

carla_mktg: Perfect  please tag @carla_mktg and @emily_eval when artifacts land. If any quantized variant fails fidelity checks well default the demo to the 3b quant and note tradeoffs in slide notes. Thanks team! :rocket:
